_what: What a program the Trillion app starts refuses to run with (computer/switch-guard.mjs). `switches`: regular expressions on its command-line switches and on NODE_OPTIONS. `variables`: environment variables that weaken it (with the value, when only one value is dangerous). `app_child_variable`: set by the app on its children (macos/computer-reader.json `environment`); the guard applies only when it is set. `token_variable` carries a support token; `support_token_blake3` is the list of BLAKE3 hashes (hex) of tokens that may allow one run. It ships empty.

words.refused: Trillion's program will not run with {list}: that would open it to a debugger or weaken its secure connections.
words.overridden: Support override accepted for this run; it is running with {list}.
